name: codex-subagent
description: Delegate a self-contained task to native Codex, using its login and settings. Requires Node.js 20+ and the native CLI.

tools.name: subagent_codex
tools.description: Delegate to native Codex in this workspace. start returns a job_id; ALWAYS poll status with wait_seconds:30 until completed/failed/timed_out/cancelled, then use its answer. cancel stops an unwanted job. One active job per extension. Tasks may edit files subject to user-configured native permissions. A job has fresh context: supply the full task. No automatic completion notification. Never claim success while running.

task.description: Required for start. Self-contained text; maximum 48 KiB.

cwd.description: Optional start-only subdirectory within the session workspace; default workspace root.

job_id.description: Required for status/cancel; use exactly the returned job_id.

wait_seconds.description: Status-only long poll; use 30 while running.
